recommended_steps.detail: Review naming, refusal and retry behavior on disposable stores. Conservative common metadata keys/scalars can block excision; a conflict grants no authority over innocent retained content. Protected/live-store adoption remains outside this release.
recommended_steps.title: Judge usability separately

what_just_landed.detail: Deleted descendants and content-free directory or metadata excision use the existing epoch/recovery mechanism. Authorized historical inventory and exact closure preview expose the required ownership.
what_just_landed.title: Delete retains; Excise removes selected managed material

what_just_landed.detail: Retained names, derived comparison keys, metadata and sanitized snapshots are checked before intent. Explicit conflicts never grant permission or silently widen deletion.
what_just_landed.title: Refuse unsafe closure before retirement

what_just_landed.detail: Both original excision planner permissions remain required for execution and pre-retirement recovery. Actual denial proofs cover execution, staging, abort and final query disclosure. Earlier qualification was withdrawn and is preserved separately.
